summary: Main race-system dispatch and phase state machine. Accumulates 3D distance checks when the steward object has a source node (this+0xA4), drives the audio DSP with a session-time-dependent parameter when an audio context exists (this+0xA8), and — unless a global enable flag is set — runs the pit timer and dispatches a race-phase machine (session-phase 7). The state machine sets per-phase control flags at this+0xC0 and this+0xC1, checks the FLT_MAX sentinel at this+0xD8 to route the progress-bar path, and delegates scoring via the Delegation global when the scoring gate equals 2.

local_names.this: steward/race-session object holding distance-check, audio, timing and flag state
local_names.a1: this object in the decompiler's register-arg spelling (ecx)
local_names.a2: incoming double on the x87 stack, reused as the audio/distance parameter source
local_names.v13: float taken from the session-time double passed to AudioDSPStateUpdate

operations.description: Proceed with 3D distance checking only when the pointer at this+0xA4 is non-zero
F_3DDistanceCheckAccumulate(v7, dbl_8AFE98) accumulates distance checks using the double at 0x008AFE98 as the parameter
Proceed with audio update only when the pointer at this+0xA8 is non-zero
When dword_8AB6E4 equals 2, Delegation(&dword_8AB6EC) routes scoring to the delegated scorer; otherwise the parameter becomes dbl_8AFEA0
AudioDSPStateUpdate(this+0xA8, parameter) updates the audio DSP state with the session-time-derived float
The pit-timer and race-phase state machine only run when byte_7C56AC is zero
Phase dispatch proceeds when bit 0 of dword_7C56A0 is set (multiplayer flag) and the phase counter dword_7C56A4 is non-negative
Average of this+0xB0 and this+0xB4 is computed and compared against dbl_8AFEA0 for the low-phase timing check
Set this+0xC0 to literal 1 when the averaged time is <= dbl_8AFEA0 (phase <= 6 and phases 5-8 paths)
Low-phase branch (dword_7C56A4 <= 6): after the timing check, falls into the sub_4D1D80(a1) call that continues the phase pipeline
Set this+0xC1 to literal 1 when the packed flag is read and byte_7CE254 is zero, marking the session-type-7 phase-control state

Session-phase-7 dispatcher: switch on dword_7C56A8 selects between the early-return/registration cases (0,1), the racing-start case (2), the LABEL_11 shared path (3,4), and the looped phase cases (5-8); default returns immediately
Case 2 racing-start test reads this+0x98 as a threshold: the condition requires the flag at this+0xC1 set and this+0x98 greater than 1.5, or the mode check failing with a session-time bound
This+0xD8 compared equal to 0x7F7FFFFF (FLT_MAX) is the case-4 sentinel that routes to the shared LABEL_11 progress-bar path instead of returning

Session-time offsets build the progress-bar record: dbl_8AFEA0 + 300.0 (cases 0/1), dbl_8AFEA0 as-is (case 2), and dbl_8AFEA0 + v12 + 2*v3 + 5.0 with v12 = 2.5 or 3.0 depending on the session-state check, where v3 is read from the flt_8AAE74 table indexed by dword_8AAE70
No value returned on the early paths; the function is invoked from GamePostMainLoop (0x0042D8A0) and StateTriggerCheck (0x004B8AE0)
